# Agent Compliance Governance

- Purpose: legal applicability monitoring, compliance control catalogue and evidence-index validation.
- Maturity: scaffolded; no legal advice, compliance determination or certification.
- Start: README.md
- Legal register: registry/legal-applicability.json
- Controls: registry/control-catalog.json
- Evidence index: registry/evidence-index.json
- Schemas: schemas/
- Validator: compliance_governance/registry.py
- CLI: python -m compliance_governance.validate_registry
- Tests: tests/
- Key boundary: proposed control is not an implemented control; source-linked legal record is not an applicability determination.
- License: pending portfolio review.
